question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Expected Value for a Random Variable with Uniform Probability
question.problem: A deck contains $10$ cards labeled with the numbers $4$, $7$, $10,…,31.$ If one card is randomly drawn from the deck, what is its expected value?
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the number on a randomly drawn card. Then the support is $S=\{4,7,10,…,31\},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{10}:$

$$
f(4)=f(7)=f(10)=…=f(31)=\frac{1}{10}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =4\cdot f(4)+7\cdot f(7)+10\cdot f(10)+…+31\cdot f(10) \\  & =\frac{4}{10}+\frac{7}{10}+\frac{10}{10}+…+\frac{31}{10} \\  & =\frac{4+7+10+13+16+19+22+25+28+31}{10} \\  & =\frac{175}{10} \\  & =17.5\,.\end{aligned}
$$
